level.title: Upper-Intermediate Urdu
goals: Communicate connected ideas accurately for the level.
Adapt register and structure to audience and purpose.
Interpret and produce Urdu with script, romanisation, and cultural awareness.

lessons.title: Comparing treatment options
lessons.learn: Compare alternatives, report procedures, and qualify claims. Choose active, passive, and impersonal wording according to what the listener needs to know. This lesson applies that control to health & doctor.

grammar.title: Comparing treatment options — discourse control
grammar.explain: Compare alternatives, report procedures, and qualify claims. Choose active, passive, and impersonal wording according to what the listener needs to know.
grammar.pattern: context + main point + support/qualification + audience-appropriate close
mistakes: Do not translate English clause order mechanically; preserve natural Urdu verb-final structure and match respect, gender, and number to the context.

practice.q: Translate precisely: مددگار (madadgar)
Write the Urdu term for: head
Produce this complete Urdu model: I am not feeling well
